changes.diffMode.unified: one stream: lines in a row, sign on the left
changes.diffMode.split: two columns: was on the left, is on the right
settings.changes.diffMode: how the diff is shown: split (two columns) or unified (one stream)
changes.diffRevertHunk: revert this hunk: make the working tree match the commit here
changes.diffNoFile: this file is not in the patch
changes.diffBinary: binary file: the patch keeps it, but there is nothing to show line by line
changes.diffOnBase: · shown on the revision the patch was made from
changes.diffNoBase: the revision this patch was made from is gone from the repository
changes.diffBroken: the patch does not apply even to its own base — it is damaged
command.changes.openFile: Open the file in the editor
command.changes.showDiff: Show the diff of the selected file
changes.ask.rollbackTitle: Roll back the changes in these files?
command.changes.escape: Clear the type-to-find, then close the diff
changes.refresh: re-read the state of the files
changes.merge.title: the shelf patch met other changes — build the version to keep
changes.unshelveRestored: the file was not in the tree — brought back from the shelf:
changes.unshelveConflict: the patch went in with conflicts: sort them out
